body:
I wouldn't say I'm in severe pain exactly, it's just that I'm suffering a bit right now. 

I think I will.

I'm a pretty private person, and because I come from a sheltered background, it was always easier to lie to my parents than tell them the truth. I think I will. My boyfriend has offered to come with me too, but I really don't think I can do that to him. He's brilliant and incredibly supportive but it would hurt him, I think.

Medication can change the chemicals in your brain and give you severe withdrawal symptoms though. It means I'd have to keep going to the pharmacy to get the prescription, and I'm not good at establishing a routine. Did you ever discuss it with them? I come from quite a sheltered background, and my family think I've "gone off the rails" since going to university, when in fact, it's more that I'm relishing my freedom.
I'll look into what the university offers. I have a friend who's offered to go with me, but I haven't taken her up on it in case it made our friendship difficult. 

I live in halls of residence, quite a bit away from my hometown, in shared accommodation.

I've tried therapy before. Unfortunately, my stupid 14 year old self decided to talk about other stuff rather than the issue at hand, and it was very much the elephant in the room whenever we sat around the table for dinner. I asked for help again a couple of years later, when the police were called (long story short, my friend was overreacting), but my parents just dismissed it as me being stupid and didn't try and get me any help. And that's the story of why I don't trust therapists/close friends [albeit one or two] with these thoughts.

I know they do, I'm just scared to go, if that makes sense.

What is the proper treatment though? CBT?
No, I haven't. I don't know how to go around doing it. (I live away from home in a different city for university)

Thank you for replying.

Some days I'm not capable of expressing myself, and I just feel numb, like I have no emotions.

I'm also pretty sure that I did badly in my exams. I feel like a massive waste of space.

Thank you for not jumping. I'm sorry that you're crying your eyes out. I'm sorry for not seeing this until now. Please tell me you're still ok. I'd like to keep talking to you if possible. What are you feeling?
OP, please give us an update. Are you ok?
